tools.name: treza_list_enclaves
tools.description: List all Treza Nitro Enclaves owned by a wallet address. Returns enclave IDs, names, statuses, regions, and configuration.

walletAddress.description: Ethereum wallet address that owns the enclaves

tools.name: treza_get_enclave
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Treza enclave including its status, configuration, provider settings, and GitHub connection.

tools.name: treza_create_enclave
tools.description: Create a new AWS Nitro Enclave with hardware-isolated TEE. The enclave will generate and manage private keys internally — keys never leave the enclave boundary. Deployment takes 2-5 minutes via Step Functions.

walletAddress.description: Ethereum wallet address of the owner

dockerImage.description: Docker image to run inside the enclave

tools.name: treza_update_enclave
tools.description: Update an existing enclave's name, description, or configuration.

tools.name: treza_delete_enclave
tools.description: Permanently delete a terminated enclave. The enclave must be in DESTROYED status before deletion.

tools.name: treza_enclave_action
tools.description: Perform a lifecycle action on an enclave: pause (stop billing), resume (restart), or terminate (destroy infrastructure). Terminate is irreversible.

tools.name: treza_get_enclave_logs
tools.description: Retrieve logs from an enclave. Supports filtering by source: ECS deployment, Step Functions workflow, Lambda triggers, application stdout/stderr, or errors only.

tools.name: treza_get_attestation
tools.description: Get the attestation document for a deployed enclave. Returns PCR measurements (enclave image hash, kernel hash, application hash, signing cert), certificate chain, and verification endpoints. Use this to cryptographically verify an enclave is running the expected code.

enclaveId.description: Enclave ID to get attestation for

tools.name: treza_verify_attestation
tools.description: Perform comprehensive cryptographic verification of an enclave's attestation. Checks PCR measurements, certificate chain, timestamp validity, nonce matching, and signature. Returns trust level (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), compliance status (SOC2, HIPAA, FIPS), and risk score.

tools.name: treza_get_verification_status
tools.description: Quick check of an enclave's verification status and trust level without performing full verification.

tools.name: treza_list_providers
tools.description: List all available enclave providers (e.g., AWS Nitro Enclave) with their supported regions and configuration schemas.

tools.name: treza_get_provider
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific enclave provider including supported regions and configuration options.

tools.name: treza_list_tasks
tools.description: List all scheduled tasks for a wallet. Tasks are cron-scheduled operations that run inside enclaves.

walletAddress.description: Wallet address that owns the tasks

tools.name: treza_create_task
tools.description: Create a new scheduled task to run inside an enclave on a cron schedule.

enclaveId.description: Enclave to run the task on

tools.name: treza_list_api_keys
tools.description: List all API keys for a wallet address. Keys have scoped permissions (enclaves:read, enclaves:write, tasks:read, tasks:write, logs:read).

walletAddress.description: Wallet address that owns the API keys

tools.name: treza_create_api_key
tools.description: Create a new scoped API key for programmatic access to the Treza platform. Returns the key only once — store it securely.

tools.name: treza_pii_scan
tools.description: Scan a JSON payload for fields that likely contain Personally Identifiable Information (PII). Uses built-in heuristics (name, email, dob, ssn, address, passport, etc.) plus any custom fields you supply. Returns a classified field list and a risk summary. Use this before passing context to a workflow step to understand what sensitive data is present.

payload.description: The JSON object (agent context or step input) to scan for PII fields

customPIIFields.description: Additional field names to treat as PII beyond the built-in heuristics (e.g. ["employeeId", "taxId"])

tools.name: treza_pii_workflow_check
tools.description: Analyse a full workflow definition and report which steps receive PII, which strip it, and flag any steps where PII would flow in despite the step declaring requiresPII: []. Use this to audit a workflow design before running it, or to document your data-flow for compliance purposes.

requiresPII.description: PII field names this step is allowed to receive

steps.description: Ordered list of workflow steps with their PII declarations

initialPayload.description: The data object that will be passed into the first step, used to show which fields are affected

tools.name: treza_redact_text
tools.description: Redact PII from a text string using the Treza redaction enclave. Returns the redacted text (PII replaced with typed placeholders like [EMAIL_1]), the detected entities, and the redaction mode (tee/standard). The original text is never stored or forwarded. Use this before sending agent context to an external LLM or storing it. Requires TREZA_API_KEY with the redact:run permission.

text.description: The text to redact. PII is detected and replaced with typed placeholders (e.g. [EMAIL_1]).

tools.name: treza_redact_chat_completions
tools.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion with PII redacted before the prompt is forwarded to the upstream model provider. Message content is stripped of PII, sent upstream, and the provider response is returned verbatim along with the Treza request id and mode. Pass rehydrate:true to also get the placeholder → original map so you can restore values in the response. Provide either modelKey (upstream key) or proxyId (a configured proxy that stores one). Requires TREZA_API_KEY with the redact:proxy permission.

content.description: Message content; PII is redacted before forwarding upstream

modelKey.description: Upstream provider API key (x-model-key). Omit when the selected proxy stores one.

proxyId.description: Configured redaction proxy id (x-treza-proxy) carrying the upstream URL, stored key, and policy

rehydrate.description: When true, also return the placeholder → original map so values can be restored in the response

tools.name: treza_pii_audit_query
tools.description: Query the PII audit log for past workflow runs. Returns PIIAccessEvent records showing which PII fields were present, allowed, and stripped at each step boundary. Filter by workflowId, walletAddress, or show only violation events where PII leaked into a step that should not have received it.

violationsOnly.description: If true, return only events where PII flowed into a step that declared requiresPII: []

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 50, max 500)
